tasks.label: 🏗️ Setup Project
tasks.command: uv venv .venv --python 3.14 && uv pip install -r requirements.txt

tasks.label: 🚀 Run Music-Splitter
tasks.command: if [ -x .venv/bin/python ]; then PY=.venv/bin/python; elif [ -x .venv/Scripts/python.exe ]; then PY=.venv/Scripts/python.exe; else echo 'ERROR: virtualenv not found. Run the "Setup Project" task first.'; exit 1; fi; exec "$PY" main.py

tasks.label: 📥 Download Inno Setup
tasks.command: mkdir -p innosetup && curl -L -o innosetup/innosetup.exe https://jrsoftware.org/download.php/is.exe && 7z x -oinnosetup innosetup/innosetup.exe -y && rm innosetup/innosetup.exe

tasks.label: 📦 Build Windows Installer
tasks.command: if [ ! -x .venv/Scripts/python.exe ]; then echo 'ERROR: run "Setup Project" first'; exit 1; fi; .venv/Scripts/python.exe -m PyInstaller music_splitter.spec && ./innosetup/ISCC.exe /Q installer/music_splitter.iss

tasks.label: 🧪 Run Tests
tasks.command: if [ -x .venv/bin/python ]; then PY=.venv/bin/python; elif [ -x .venv/Scripts/python.exe ]; then PY=.venv/Scripts/python.exe; else echo 'ERROR: virtualenv not found. Run the "Setup Project" task first.'; exit 1; fi; exec "$PY" -m unittest discover tests
